reply_text:
I answered Hollis in a reply to his message in #central-team. The only deadline on record is the one Pree posted there on 14 Oct: Tansley Parcel's signed order form is due 25 August.

I also told him the date isn't confirmed. Pree didn't give a year, and 25 August had already passed when she posted it. I asked her on the 14th whether she meant next year or a different date, and she hasn't replied. I suggested he check with her before putting it in the account sheet.

I couldn't back the date up with any files, because I can't see any account files. The Tansley incident channel, which Hollis is in, doesn't mention the order form either.

A deadline date is operational information, not a finance figure, so it was fine to share with someone on the account's team.
